name: Gamen kara Detekita Oshi Vtuber to H na Dousei Seikatsu ~Kemo Mimi Game Haishinsha wa Downer-kei.~
original_name: 画面から出てきた推しVtuberとHな同棲生活 ～ケモ耳ゲーム配信者はダウナー系。～
source:
Masato Kasakabe has a miserable job that's constantly overworking him.
His sole pleasure is supporting his favorite vtubers.

"Ahh, if only my oshi jumped through the screen right now..."

Masato starts fantasizing about living with his oshi.
But that could never happen for real...

Until suddenly, he ends up with three of his favorites as his roommates.
With vtubers now existing in the flesh, a dimension-spanning love story begins now...


[b]Chill and vibey beast girl game streamer[/b]

Popota is sickly due to her unhealthy lifestyle.

While trying to get the typically inattentive and careless Popota excited about something, Masato takes care of her.

Then, one day, he hears groaning noises coming from her room.
When he opens the door, he finds...

translation:
笠部正人的工作很糟糕，经常让他超负荷工作。
他唯一的乐趣就是支持他最喜欢的vtuber。

“啊啊，要是我的大神现在就跳出画面就好了……”

正人开始幻想与他的oshi一起生活。
但这永远不可能真正发生……

直到突然之间，他终于和三个他最喜欢的人成为了室友。
随着vtuber们现身，一场跨次元的爱情故事即将开始……


[b]Chill and Viby野兽女孩游戏主播[/b]

波波塔因不健康的生活方式而体弱多病。

在试图让典型的漫不经心和粗心的波波塔对某件事感到兴奋的同时，正人照顾了她。

然后，有一天，他听到她的房间里传来呻吟声。
当他打开门时，他发现……
